#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);
    int n, B;
    cin >> n >> B;
    vector<int> arr(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        cin >> arr[i];
    }
    priority_queue<int, vector<int>, std::greater<int>> pq; // Min-heap
    int e = 0, o = 0;

    for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; ++i) {
        int ele = arr[i];
        if (ele % 2 == 0)
            e++;
        else
            o++;
        if (e == o) {
            pq.push(abs(arr[i] - arr[i + 1]));
        }
    }

    long long ans = 0;
    while (B >= 0 && !pq.empty()) {
        int cost = pq.top();
        pq.pop();
        B -= cost;
        if (B < 0) break;
        ans++;
    }

    cout << ans << "\n";

    return 0;
}
